shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. Levels chosen per colony against a total-cell budget; colder with altitude, richer ore and more cave with depth. Multi-level rendering and interaction verified working.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. ~58 files / ~14,600 LOC.

## Pitch
Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`; bands along **+z** from the deepest basement; permanently-fogged gutter between bands; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)×64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing**. Per-level sizes 126 / 190 / 254 (each just under a 64 boundary ⇒ ~1-2% gutter waste).

### The one insight
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum; `Reachability.CanReach` works **unpatched**. **But reachability ≠ a path** — 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and can't traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

### Dividing line
Graph/logic = FREE. Geometry/presentation = NOT free; fix per draw/compute site.

### Hard 1.6 constraints
Jobified pathfinder — path grid is an IJobParallelFor over EVERY cell, so **total stacked cells is the perf metric** · no `PathFinder.FindPath` · `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — total-cell budget
Player picks levels above (0-3) / below (0-3) on the advanced-config screen against **`CellBudget = 115,000`**. More levels slices the same budget thinner rather than multiplying cost.
`3×190 = 109,440` · `5×126 = 80,640` · **`7×126 = 112,896`** · `7×190 = 255,360` (refused).
`ABMapSizeLimit` owns the plan (`UpperLevels`/`LowerLevels`/`BandCount`/`SurfaceBand = lower`/`Fits`/`MaxSize`). `ABV2.BandCount`/`SurfaceBand` are properties (were consts — the only thing pinning the mod to 3). UI lives in a strip at the bottom of a window made 170px taller via an `InitialSize` postfix — **don't guess free space in someone else's dialog; add height and own it**. `bandCount <= 1` ⇒ ordinary unbanded map.

# 3. CROSS-BAND MOVEMENT — multi-hop
Segmented at ONE interception: `StartPath` prefix rewrites the destination to the near anchor → tick sweep carries the pawn → `Carry` re-issues `StartPath` to the true destination.
`ABWormhole.TryGetTransit` **BFSes the band graph** and returns the best pair whose far band is `hops-1` from the target; chaining is free because each leg re-plans. Hops must strictly decrease or pawns ping-pong. Previously required a single pair spanning (from,to) — which capped journeys at one flight while reachability said yes.
**Caveat:** an intermediate level must be walkable between arrival and the next staircase. Sky levels are mostly impassable open air, so stacked stair towers work; flights far apart on a sky level strand a pawn. **Still untested in play** (test maps have had no stairs built).

# 4. ⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE — `ABBands.TryResolveVisibleBelow`
Descends while each level is see-through, stops at the first opaque floor or the bottom band, returns the accumulated `drop`. **Six systems now share it**: `SectionLayer_ABBelowV2`, `ABBelowClickThrough`, `ABBelowOverlays`, `ABBelowDynamicDraw`, `ABBelowSelectionDraw`, `ABBelowMultiSelect`.
A single `- Slot` step works on a 3-level map and breaks the instant two see-through levels stack. **This class of bug appeared five separate times** (renderer, click-through, overlays, pawn draw, selection, drag-select) — each found only when the user walked levels 0→3 and reported which floor broke. **Still single-band:** the realtime-things pass in `ABBelowDynamicDraw` (motes, fire).
Also fixed: the **dirty mirror** now invalidates EVERY band above, not one — levels 2+ were holding stale bakes and never learned the ground changed ("mineables disappear on floor 2/3"; not masking or translation, just a mesh nobody invalidated).

# 5. SKY-MASS PRESENTATION — verified in play
**⚠ FOUR REJECTED ATTEMPTS — do not revisit:** force-linked wall masks (flat mask-15) · high-queue cover (erased overhanging sprites) · wall-sprite suppression (broke legibility; ore → glyphs) · guessing at the cause of "flat" mountains twice before running the diagnostics.
**Settled: vanilla sprites always draw; redundant outlines are a GENERATION problem.** Despeckle (majority filter; **wall dissolves only at 7+ open neighbours** — at 6 it ate the outermost wall row off every meadow edge, which is why plateau edges stopped reading as mountain edges; conversions need all 8 neighbours in-mass so the rim survives) · one central fog hole (depth ≥3, components <24 dropped) · five-terrain plateau palette (fertility × independent moisture) · cliff faces (`CliffFaceDepth 2`, `FaceDarkest 0.42`; vertex colour multiplies so rock detail survives) · alpine pass (shallow-only tarns, per-cell 6-cell edge rule; rim scree via `"Chunk"+defName`; exposure-thinned flora).
**Cross-band decoration (this session, verified):** `EmitMassSilhouetteAt` + static `EmitMeadowFadeAt` emit the mass' lip, corner fillers, cliff shading and meadow fades into ANY layer at a z offset, so a mountain seen from 2-3 levels up matches the one you stand on. Diagnosed from a below-layer report showing substituted rough stone and **no edge material at all** — nothing was failing to print; the decoration lived in the other band's mesh. Scratch arrays are caller-owned (no per-cell allocation).
**Ore glyph bug:** ore defs have no `naturalTerrain` (`TerrainDefGenerator_Stone` skips `isResourceRock`) ⇒ a "can't happen" fallback drew the whole **atlas sheet** per cell. `IsHostStone()` gate + fallback deleted.

# 6. PER-LEVEL CHARACTER
Sky temp `-4°C × level` (compounds) · **snow line is free**: vanilla melts snow per-CELL temperature, so cold high levels hold snow and the line moves seasonally; gen only seeds the opening state (level ≥+2, effective temp < -2 °C) · basement flat -6 (deep rock converges; geothermal deferred) · ore `×(1+0.45×(depth-1))` and cave openness `×(1+0.35×(depth-1))`, both applied AFTER the settings clamp so the slider is the level-1 baseline · mountains taper upward for free (each sky level projects from the band below; ascending generation order).

# 7. CAMERA
`freeCameraPan` REMOVED. `ABCameraBounds.For(level)` baked table keyed by **level**. Calibrated on a 126 band: `panMargin 63.5` baked for +1/+3, **`maxZoom` left DERIVED** — the measured 60.0 was just where the camera stopped, derive is 63.0, and an absolute would mis-scale a 190 band (derive 95). `Dialog_ABCameraCalibration` opens with the clamp UNLOCKED — **a calibration tool must suspend the limit it calibrates**. View-rect clip always active.

# 8. ⚠ THE LOAD BOUNDARY (root-caused, verification still pending)
`ConstructComponents()` creates a transient EMPTY `ABBandMap` that mid-load rendering latches. Fix: `CompOf` never caches while `Scribe.mode != Inactive` + `FinalizeInit` rebinds every cache. uniqueID-keyed statics → CWT; load camera move deferred.

# 9. GEN / PERF — measured
3 levels @190: gensteps 1538 ms, carve 5001 ms. **7 levels @126: gensteps 3593 ms, carve 30,420 ms** — `Sky clear` 18.2 s of it, and `FillRock` escalates 1166→2210→3943 ms for identical work. That escalation is the **crowdedness signature**: `ListerThings.Remove` is linear, so every one of 20,446 spawned rocks makes each later destroy dearer. Total cells stayed flat; destroy cost scaled. **The budget bounds play cost, NOT generation cost.**
**Biggest open optimisation:** extend the doomed-band skip (which took gen 16.9 s → 4.2 s for plants) to the other per-cell gensteps — RocksFromGrid, RockChunks, ScatterRuinsSimple, CaveHives, MutatorPostElevationFertility. Attacks both the work and the lister size. Per-cell gensteps scope safely; `map.Area`-count scatterers do NOT.
Runtime: 59.6 fps @96 pawns, mod ≈2% frame. All rendering is bake-time section-mesh geometry.

# 10. VERTICAL LINKS — elevator SHIPPED, untested. Full-mesh 2×2; **mesh is O(n²) in band count** (7 levels = 21 pairs). Known: `Carry` latent hole.

# 11. DIAGNOSTICS
band info · **below layer report** (submesh dump — this is what finally cracked the flat-mountain bug; use it before theorising) · below pawn report (DRAW/SKIP with reason) · transit health · stuck probe · transit logging · lighting/shader/biome reports · bisect toggles · ABGenProfile · camera calibration · `CliffFaceDepth`.

# 12. OPEN WORK
1. **Drafted group-move**: 3 drafted pawns on ONE level → only one moves, one ghost. User confirmed SAME level, so `TrySegment` early-returns and this is provably not the wormhole pather. Next step: isolation run with **no companions** (Circinus is the prime suspect). Do NOT edit our code until that discriminates.
2. **Generation-cost scoping pass** (§9) — largest remaining perf item.
3. Multi-hop stairs still unexercised in play; elevator untested; reload fix unverified (menu-load, load-while-playing, double cycle, now also at 7 bands).
4. Realtime-things pass still single-band (motes/fire >1 level down).
5. **Option E — waterfalls**: water spike FIRST (below-view water unproven; tarns don't de-risk it — same-band water).
6. COMBAT never verified · Option C (stepped mesa) parked · vertical conduit · compat audit (incl. BM co-load) · transplant · store page still says three levels.

# 13. LESSONS (telegraphic)
**Run the diagnostic before the third theory** — two wrong guesses cost two cycles; the submesh dump answered it instantly · measure, don't reason (Option D gen estimate wrong 100×) · **a single-step assumption survives until the data has two steps — when generalising a count, grep for `X + 1`, `== N`, and every `- Slot`** · never hide sprites that carry gameplay information · visual noise in generated content is a GENERATION bug · ore defs have no naturalTerrain · a `Graphic_Linked` base material is the whole ATLAS SHEET · **"can't happen" fallbacks are what the player photographs** · enforce spatial rules PER CELL, not seed+radius · key authored tables by stable semantics (level), not index · **budget the real cost, don't cap a proxy** · a per-leg re-planning router needs only the FIRST HOP of a BFS · don't guess free space in another mod's dialog · never a queue-above-cutout cover · clip geometry to cells you own · vertex colour on terrain dims the real texture (multiply) · statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak — CWT · never cache comps while Scribe active · FinalizeInit = worker thread · altitude ≠ draw order but IS the cutout depth tiebreaker · `material.shader =` resets renderQueue · static Unity-asset fields need `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]` · when art is in asset bundles, playtest screenshots are a legitimate mockup source.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`. Companions: `astryl.Circinus` + `astryl.ModernDevTools` + `BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns` + `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework` — **drop these for isolation runs when a bug might not be ours**. Multi-level tests need `quicktest=false` (levels are chosen on the map-size screen). Reload tests need load-while-playing.
